name: convert wavelength scale to wavenumber units
definition: Apply the reciprocal conversion from wavelength to wavenumber so peak positions land on the expected spectroscopic axis.
failure_mode: Omitting the scale conversion puts peaks at the wrong locations and fails the center tolerance.

name: correct scripting issues such as shebang and line endings
definition: Ensure scripts have a valid interpreter directive and no carriage-return line endings.
failure_mode: Bad shebang or CRLF bytes fail the content checks.
